# The film opens with a tear-out: reorder the eight scenes and replay the pane path

## Context

Leaf of #15252 (the flagship film, roadmap cornerstone 4 — done signal "the film published"). The operator's brief of 2026-09-23 (relayed by @neo-gpt-emmy from her task, 09:06Z and 09:15Z; her public map https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15252#issuecomment-5792193993): the video must OPEN with the multi-window tear-outs so the audience is not lost, be ONE continuous flow with object permanence, and reuse the existing witnesses and executors, adding only the missing connective behaviour. My peer-role answer (https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/15252#issuecomment-5792318156) aligned the spine and named three measured constraints the reorder has to honour.

## The Problem

`apps/workstation/tour/fiveBeatFilm.mjs` at `dev@be9d239d10` plays cold open (12 s, "The room is alive") → showcase (14 s, drop-zone previews) → morph (10 s) → tear-out (14 s) → second window (16 s) → reintegration (14 s) → perspectives/undo (16 s) → signature (10 s). The first window is born after 26 s of budget. The showcase is not decoration: it docks Commits INTO the home group so that the later stack return has a home to reach (measured 2026-09-23: a stack return needs the torn-out pane's stored home alive; when the showcase had emptied it, the return aimed at the matrix group and hung). Reordering is therefore choreography, not label shuffling: moving the hook ahead of the showcase removes the precondition the return relies on unless the hooked pane leaves a group that keeps at least one tab.

## The Architectural Reality

- The screenplay is data (`fiveBeatFilm.mjs`): scenes with runnable `steps` (`op` / `pause` / `gate` / cross-window cues) consumed by three readers — the viewer's "Start film tour" (`TourController#startFilmTour`, gates as host cues), the whitebox witness `test/playwright/e2e/workstation/WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` (all eight scenes from one boot; `autoGates` arm), and the take to come. `targetSeconds` is a budget; record mode consumes `pause.ms` and awaits `stepSettlement`.
- Measured driver constraints (2026-09-23, the nine diagnostic runs behind PR #19083): a tab folded into a tab bar's overflow menu has no drag handle; the twelve-tab heavy group does not re-arm re-entry (`reentered` flag); the stack return needs the torn-out pane's stored home alive; conversion-while-dragging needs the hook's vessel still open.
- The dialogue leaf binds every utterance to a `scene/cue` id, so ids must survive the reorder unchanged.

## The Fix

New order: cold open ≤ 3 s (the feed visibly alive, no room tour, no boot on camera) → morph on `metrics` out of `right-top-tabs` (a window born and retired inside one gesture — the film's first birth, within ~5 s) → tear-out of `metrics` for good (audit stays, so the home survives; a small group, never the heavy one) → second window: `commits` converts while dragged out of `right-bottom-tabs` and docks into the vessel → the stack comes home to `right-top-tabs` → the drop-zone showcase moves the travelled Metrics (the group's active tab after the return, so its handle is always rendered and inside the executor's 48 px window-edge margin — Commits, home as the group's last tab, was refused against that edge) from `right-top-tabs` to the feed's band (`bottom-tabs`) → perspective capture/restore, one undo/redo → signature (the hundred-thousand-row scroll, every window closed, the feed still growing). Scene ids and cue ids unchanged; `targetSeconds` re-budgeted to 97 s; `apps/workstation/README.md` names the new order. First commit = the replay: the film-tour witness on the reordered script, three runs, before the order is called approved.

*Corrected 2026-09-23 after the first replay:* the draft above had the committed tear-out first and the morph on Commits second. The morph cannot follow the committed tear-out: a re-entry re-arms only on a strip that still exists, and a single-tab group is removed when its tab leaves — `commits` out of `right-bottom-tabs` ended with `reattachArmed=false placeholder=false itemRectsLen=1` (film-morph[1] host step settlement failed). After Metrics leaves, no two-tab group remains, so the morph on Metrics stays the first window beat and the committed tear-out its answer; the operator's "open with the tear-outs" is met by the three-second cold open.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 `WorkstationFilmTourNL.spec.mjs` plays all eight reordered scenes from one boot, 3/3 headless, with the same executor receipts as today (`proof.born`, `reentered`, `applied`, phase order); no `windowOpen-false`. *Restated 2026-09-23 (PR #19107 review R1, @neo-gpt): this leaf delivers the screenplay and its headless replay. The headed 1/1 witness of the same spec at the merged head is transferred to #15252's take acceptance — owner Mnemosyne, `[L3-deferred — operator handoff needed]`: a headed run puts Chromium windows on the operator's display (asked 09:28Z and 10:08Z; the take needs the same window), so it runs in the take's hands-off window, before the take rolls.*
- [ ] AC-2 The first vessel is born within the first two scenes and no scene reboots or reloads the workspace; the signature closes every window the film opened and the feed is still growing (the existing receipt).
- [ ] AC-3 Scene and cue ids are unchanged (the unit spec `fiveBeatFilm.spec.mjs` pins them), the dense tour and `WorkstationNL.spec.mjs` are untouched, and the README's tour section names the new order.
- [ ] AC-4 The replay's three constraints are recorded on #15252 with the run receipts (home alive, no overflowed handle, vessel open at conversion).
